description: Lists designs in the NightMarquee library, with a title, tagline, category, a poster, a short preview clip, whether a starter pack exists and a live demo link for each. Filter by words, category, free or paid, and page through the results with the cursor. Use it to find a design before reading it with get_design. It needs no account; `open` says whether the connected account can read a design's build prompt. Each call shows the user its own picker, so search once with broad words rather than several narrow searches.

category.description: A category slug from the `categories` list of an earlier search. An unknown category returns no designs.

cursor.description: The `cursor` from the previous result, to read the next page.

kind.description: The kind of design. Only `site` exists today; any other kind returns no designs.

limit.description: How many designs to return, 1 to 50. The default is 10.

query.description: Words to look for in a design's title, tagline, description, style keywords, category and the businesses it suits, such as restaurant, hotel or florist.

tier.description: Only free designs, or only designs that need a plan.

name: search_designs
title: Search designs
